crossRefs.note: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!
For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.
Sing to Yahweh a new song! Sing to Yahweh, all the earth.
Sing to Yahweh! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!
Sing to Yahweh a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for…
Sing praises to Yahweh with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.
“Hear, you kings! Give ear, you princes! I, even I, will sing to Yahweh. I will sing praise to Yahweh, the God of…
Sing to Yahweh, for he has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!
Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion; for the Holy One of Israel is great among you!”
Sing to Yahweh a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, you who go down to the sea, and all that is…
speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works…
Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship…
I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.
We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of Yahweh, his strength, and…
Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.
You shall tell your son in that day, saying, ‘It is because of that which Yahweh did for me when I came out of Egypt.’
It shall be for a sign to you on your hand, and for a memorial between your eyes, that Yahweh’s law may be in your…
It shall be, when your son asks you in time to come, saying, ‘What is this?’ that you shall tell him, ‘By strength of…
These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart;
They talked with each other about all of these things which had happened.

parallels.note: Sing to him. Sing praises to him. Tell of all his marvelous works.

translations.web: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.
translations.bsb: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; tell of all His wonders.
translations.kjv: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.
translations.asv: Sing unto him, sing praises unto him; Talk ye of all his marvelous works.
